what: Text rises into focus out of a blur — the heading type starts 40px lower, 20px blur and transparent, 1.6s expo.out, the hand type (handwritten heading) starts at 5px blur and transparent, 1.4s expo.out, the fade type starts 40px lower and transparent, 2s expo.out, with items entering at the same time staggered by .15s. Items already inside the first screen play as soon as it opens, and items below play once when their top edge reaches 80% of the screen (150px above the bottom for fade)

options.y: Initial downward offset (px), default 40 (0 for hand)
options.start: When setting the ScrollTrigger start directly
options.delay: Delay after entering (seconds), default 0 — for staggering the photo, title and text of the same section by .1s
